idea-plugin.name: Webhook Signature Companion
idea-plugin.description:
Gutter warning icon on any Java/Kotlin Spring MVC endpoint whose mapping path contains "webhook" with no signature-verification signal anywhere in the handler body -- the classic footgun where anyone who guesses (or finds leaked) the endpoint URL can send a forged event, because nothing checks that the payload really came from the real sender.

100% static text/PSI analysis -- matches the mapping path and a broad set of signature-verification signals (method names like verifySignature, or raw text like hmac/Mac.getInstance) by simple text, so it works whether the real Spring/crypto libraries are on the classpath or not. Java and Kotlin.

Stated honestly: v0.1 only recognizes "webhook" in the mapping path itself -- an endpoint named differently (e.g. /events/stripe without the word "webhook") isn't covered. It also can't confirm the verification logic is actually *correct*, only that a real attempt exists.

Free. No license nags, no telemetry, no network calls.
